name: APG_ImYourCFGNow (noise space, adaptive momentum)
plain: APG implemented as a cfg function in noise space. Includes a built-in guidance limiter and an adaptive momentum that decays through the schedule. Projection is on the noise prediction, whereas core projects on x0.
math:
c,u = x−x̂
β_t = β − β·a⁴·(1000−t) (floor 0; mirrored for β<0)
v ← β_t·v + (c−u); g=v
g ← g·min(1, T/‖g‖)
g' = g⊥ + η·g∥ relative to c
f = c + (s−1)·g'
Limiter on, outside window: f = c

props.params: momentum=0.5, adaptive_momentum=0.18, norm_threshold=15.0, eta=1.0, guidance_limiter=false, guidance_sigma_start=5.42, guidance_sigma_end=0.28

label: from code
surprise: Same name, different space and formula: f = c + (s−1)·g′ with projection onto x−x̂_c. Core APG is x0-space and leaves an extra Δ term. Buffer resets only at t==999 or on a shape change.
